description:
**"Clearly, I was only supposed to provide the milk... So why is he kissing me?!"**

Mary has a secret she has guarded her entire life: despite being a virgin, her body produces breast milk. Desperate for a fresh start after years of humiliation, she secures a job at a prestigious marquisate; only to be exposed on day 1 by Asher, the brilliant eldest son and lead medical researcher.

Expecting the worst, Mary is stunned when Asher offers her a confidential contract: treatment for her condition in exchange for regular milk samples.
The arrangement seems straightforward enough; until Asher’s physical examinations begin crossing every professional boundary imaginable.

 As the line between medical research and undeniable desire blurs, Asher makes a revelation of his own:
**"Forget the research data, Mary. It's you I want to analyze."**
